KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. zito
   D. nene

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

4. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.

5. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

9. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.

10. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Dukani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
